This '''[[Munificent-class star frigate|''Munificent''-class star frigate]]''' was in service during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in the [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Confederate Navy]]. Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], the [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] was shot down over [[Carlac/Legends|Carlac]] by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]. The Republic sent [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] down to deal with the remaining droids, but they encountered [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] [[Skirmish on Carlac|resistance]]. [[Unidentified Jedi Knight (Clone Wars)|A Jedi Knight]] investigated the wreck, destroying many droids including [[IG-113]].
